posts.text: Hi, I had a technical question. What is the management referring to when they say ‘organic’ revenue especially after the Sojern acquisition? Do they mean ex of Sojern or do they mean revenue that’s adjusted for timing differences due to the acquisition being done in Q3FY26… so FY26 (includes 12months of RG + about 5 months Sojern revenue) vs (FY27 which will include RG+Sojern for full 12 months)? Specifically, how is the 70% YoY guidance for FY27 full year (3100cr) that they gave (vs) 15-20% organic guidance different differ conceptually? Would be really helpful if someone can clarify! image 1…
